intro.heading: Early read
intro.body: This matchup is two weeks away, and Tomball still plays Cinco Ranch and Klein Forest before coming to Klein Memorial. The numbers below are a starting point. The full forecast, current records and final player list will update on game day.

players.name: Jace Hanks
players.copy: Hanks completed 15 of 24 passes in the opener and accounted for 285 total yards. His early efficiency gives Cain a useful counter to Tomball’s run-heavy approach.

players.name: Eyan Johnson
players.copy: Johnson needed 11 carries to reach 110 yards against Humble. Tomball opened with five sacks, so Cain’s ability to stay ahead of the chains will matter.

players.name: Cooper Karns
players.copy: Karns produced 110 yards and a touchdown in the opener. He gives Hanks an established target when Tomball commits extra bodies to the run.

players.name: Trevon Johnson
players.copy: Johnson led Tomball’s ground game in the 38–0 win over Stratford. The 6-foot, 205-pound senior is the first test for a Cain defense that gave up 41 in Week 1.

players.name: Ian Thomas
players.copy: Thomas is the centerpiece of this matchup. The four-star junior ran for 1,528 yards and 20 touchdowns as a sophomore, and 247Sports now ranks him the nation’s No. 1 running back and No. 39 overall prospect in the 2028 class. His father, Rodney Thomas, was an all-time Texas high-school great, a two-time first-team All-SWC back at Texas A&M and a six-year NFL player.

players.name: Andres von der Meden
players.copy: Von der Meden committed to Texas A&M on June 8. Rivals lists him as the No. 5 kicker in the 2027 class, giving Tomball a nationally recruited specialist who can turn field position into points.
